messages.subject: arrowheads with geom_path()
parts:
I am trying to plot trajectories using geom_path, and the arrow()
function nested within. The color of the path is mapped to a variable.

Everything plots correctly, except that when I try to plot closed arrowheads
Here's an example of the script I'm using (with mtcars):

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=wt, y=mpg, colour=cyl))+
geom_path(arrow=arrow(type="closed"))

I end up with solid white arrowheads, when I'd like to use the same
mapping as the line color. Using fill=cyl doesn't seem to do anything.

Any advice?

Thank you!
